definitions.peak_and_L: method3.metric: true axial force peak after t>=1 s, L=log1p(J); startup is included in event search and window statistics
definitions.events: First departure after a channel has first entered [0.75,1.3]. All departures, both directions, and the first upper departure are retained; no crossing is automatically called destabilizing.
definitions.low_window_targets: First either-direction exit, first upper exit, first upper exit in the prepeak second, and largest fractional accepted downward update in that second; no force-peak causality inferred solely from order.
definitions.spatial_freeze: Material lookup location fixed at the window-end contact location, only within the target regression window, with original prefix state. Load/activation dependence of true tangent is retained.
definitions.gate_prior_free: Only the precision comparison uses sigma<=rel_max*k_hat. The original floor guard and prior-based measurement bound are retained.
definitions.kgood_limit: Limit the final, centred k_good decrease to (1-rho_d) times prior k_good per estimator call; rising is unchanged.
definitions.exc_from_kbar: Only the excitation denominator changes after k_good is finite. Initial k_seek acquisition, feed-forward, and feedback remain the adopted paths.
definitions.both: kgood_limit plus exc_from_kbar, and no other policy changes
definitions.probe_amplitude: a_force*exc_gain*k/k_un; current, prior, and in-window amplitudes are recorded separately for each forensic window.
definitions.H_tests: Conditional regression re-estimation at original commands, noise, calibration and phase schedule. H_mag_fixed changes only mag_h to its window-end value; original_rebuilt verifies the sampled transform exactly.
definitions.motion_check: Depth equation is checked on every 0.5 ms substep, with mass and the calibrated sensing path transformed. Literal command+u replay depth errors are separately retained; the depth-exact inverse command need not respect 8 ms holds.
definitions.null: Unavailable/unevaluated/invalid scalar, or unbounded histogram endpoint; gate path distinguishes no valid estimate from rejection.
definitions.resources: At most 6 simulation worker processes; BLAS/Numba thread limits 1; no external services or hardware; no git mutations
